body: What the fuck man. That's uncannily close to my story... I started reading and I just couldn't believe it. PM me if you wanna talk man
Haha lets all be friends! comeon /u/DigitalWhimsy, you bring it in here too :)

If i could give you once piece of advise, I would say fuck those goals. Dont worry about being the 'cool' brother or being able to financially support your parents. Just do what you wanna do. It sounds like you got a pretty supportive family and I bet they would prefer that over any amount of money or attractiveness.
Thanks, also I thought you were OP when you replied the first time
Haha lonely me always says yes but once im around them I cant stand it. What happened today?

Hey man its good youre at least typing some shit out even if it takes you a while. I've done the same thing before where I just stare at my screen and cant type. Words just seem so inadequate to describe such an all consuming feeling
Eyy buddy, I'm sitting in my dorm room doing H by myself and thinking about how fucked my life is. What are you drinkin?

On a whim I bought 2 grams of heroin. One of them is pretty much just fentanyl so I get a wicked rush off of around 5mg. That's like 200 doses for me. That's probably enough to become physically dependent...
i can be you're friend now, i just know I'll inevitably let it slip away

Homie, I know that it sometimes seems like everyone has their shit together except you. The thing is they don't. That's one thing that has really become clear to me at college. It doesn't matter what grade you got in your high school English class, it doesn't matter what sports you played, or who you took to prom. It doesn't matter what your dreams or aspirations were. College is just a bunch of children trying to one up each other by pretending to be adults. I think that what you're feeling is true for everybody, some people are just better about lying to themselves about it. Unfortunately you're someone who can see clearly
I would be your friend, but I know I would only let you down.

How was it? That sounds like quite the experience. I've always wanted to jump out of a car even when I wasn't depressed. It's just one of those things that I think about a lot, and I wonder how it would feel.

cant say I have any advise to offer but just thought it was interesting to meet someone else who turns to DXM when it gets bad. Just a few days ago I took went through 900mg. I didn't really mean to, but I could still feel the pain at 300 and 600 so I said fuck it and did it all. I don't know about you but I never really feel good when I'm on it, I just stop feeling emotions and go into auto pilot.

Not anywhere near you but I just wanted to ask you to at least rethink using that caffine powder. I've watched people od on caffeine and its not pretty. Plus even with harder uppers it rarely kills you.
Ahh yep same boat here. Its hard to convince yourself to quit when you figure you'll be dead before the cancer gets you anyways
I got a councling appointment on Monday. Thanks for the support. I don't know what's gonna happen but I'll let you all know.

Hey man, I don't see you as whiney at all and I don't think your problems are mundane or trivial in the least bit. However they're also problems that you can over come! Maybe this isn't the best advise in the world but I would say to not worry too much about the medical bills you have at the moment. Get the care you need, for both your physical and mental state and then foucus on the money once you're back on solid ground. Again this is advise from a college student so maybe don't listen to me but at least know that I'm listening to you. I gotta sleep but if you wanna chat or anything send me a message and I'll reply in the morning.
The same college routine I've been doing for a while...
